reader_summary.overview: Announcing a16z Journal Club, a new show where we curate and discuss recent research papers with a16z experts and others. This new show continues the a16z Podcast mission of not just bringing you conversations about the future (as well as about building companies for this). The first episode, of bio journal club, focuses on why specific scientific advances matter from our perspective at the intersection of biology & technology.
